description: This file is a PHP source code defining an admin controller class for managing customer custom fields in an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting custom fields, along with associated view and model interactions.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer custom fields within the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method for setting up the custom fields page. Loads language, sets title, breadcrumbs, and views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of custom fields by calling getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares a paginated list of custom fields with sorting options for display.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a custom field, preloading data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a custom field, validates inputs, and saves data.
